I am a PhD candidate in Computational Science, Engineering and Mathematics at the Oden Institute, UT Austin. My research interests include:

* Design and analysis of mathematical models to study physical and biological phenomena
* Development and implementation of algorithms for HPC
* Real-time, High-fidelity Bayesian Inverse Problems

with applications in tsunami early warning. Working with scientists and engineers from different fields, I hope to use interdisciplinary approaches to solve problems.
